findings.assessment: Says long wall-clock solves mean control inputs were reused rather than recomputed each 10 ms step. The synchronous scheduling contract completes each controller call before fixed simulation steps; wall-time overruns do not establish skipped simulated updates. Initialization selection is separately recorded.

Calls sampled holding a speed rather than position failure despite the cited 0.05813810428573256 m maximum error exceeding the 0.01 m holding position limit. Terminal reach acceptance does not imply holding-window position acceptance.

Claims warm plans/solver iteration traces are required to locate when measured tip speed stopped decreasing. The retained sampled backend trajectory can answer that sampled-motion question; optimizer plans are needed for different questions.

No execution means no newly measured effect. The broader claim that geometry cannot affect solver timing/status or the holding excursion is unsupported; geometry can affect the model and optimization problem. The absence of evidence for a beneficial edit is narrower.
The approximate 32x speed ratio is arithmetic derived from retrieved values, not a separately retrieved computation result under this experiment's stated derived-number provenance rule.
